description: This file provides API client functions for interacting with backend services, including environment-based URL normalization, health checks, and customer data retrieval, with support for mocking and error suppression.

methods.name: getHealthUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the health check endpoint, considering mock mode and environment variables.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check by calling the backend or returning mock data, with error handling and fallback.

methods.name: listCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers from the backend or mock data, with error handling.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific customer's data by ID from the backend or mock data, with error handling.
